Pets: up to two pets considered, dog weight limit 70 lbs, pet rent $35/mo per pet, non-refundable pet fee $300. Tenant responsible for electricity (approx $85) and gas; water, sewer and garbage billed through the provider. Internet: Xfinity available, about $60/month, tenant arranges. Security deposit $2,395. Application fee: $38.75 per applicant (includes credit check). Covered parking: 1 carport space $40/mo. 2nd car only: additional space rent for $75. Lease term 12 months; 6 month lease available at $2,550. Walk to Heather Elementary, 0.4 miles. Open house Sunday 1-3pm.
